analysisScope: Completed immutable reports only; no measurement, build, source or protocol edits
populationDefinition: All 20 registered seeds; null sorts after reached; index floor((N-1)*q). Worst is null when any seed is censored.
conditionalDefinition: Reached observations only; same lower-index quantile convention. Unreached retained in denominator.
units: seconds unless explicitly named minutes; bigint damage and power preserved as decimal strings

validation.checks: Independent raw/manifest/file hash checks; archived source/evaluator/build digests; 20 canonical seeds; record/checkpoint consistency; conditional summaries and population target recomputation

selection.rule: Screening: population firstAccepted p50 2700..3600sec and >=18/20 by5400sec. Full12h: both plus population h70 eligibility p50 28800..43200sec. Rank by abs(first p50-3150), abs(final p50-36000), population first p90, ID.
